title: DesktopErrorMappingV1
description: How the frozen POLARIS error vocabulary becomes a UI-facing category, and what is allowed to cross the trust boundary with it. This is a mapping over the existing vocabulary, never a second error universe.
$comment: لا كون أخطاء ثانٍ. الفئة المعروضة مشتقة من ErrorCode المجمَّد، والاشتقاق مُصرَّح به هنا ويُفحص باختبار اكتمال: رمز قانوني بلا فئة عيبٌ يُوقف البناء.

DesktopErrorCategory.title: DesktopErrorCategory
DesktopErrorCategory.description: The nine categories a Phase-01 screen may render. Closed: a tenth category is a contract change, not a string a component invents.

Redaction.title: Redaction
Redaction.description: Default redaction applied before an error crosses to the renderer. STRIP_INTERNAL_DETAIL removes internal_detail and keeps the JSON pointer; STRIP_ALL_DETAIL removes both, for errors whose pointer would itself describe host internals.

canonical_codes.description: The frozen error codes that produce this category. The union over all entries must cover the whole vocabulary; a completeness test proves it.

retryable.description: Whether the shell may offer a retry. A retry offered for a permanent failure teaches the user to distrust the button.

detail_may_cross_boundary.description: Whether internal_detail may reach the renderer. In Phase-01 this is false for every entry; a trusted diagnostics path is a later phase and would have to flip this in the open.

display_key.description: Localization key for the message shown. The contract carries no prose.

DesktopErrorView.title: DesktopErrorView

correlation_id.description: So a user-visible failure can be found in the host log without the host log crossing the boundary.

pointer.description: Present only when the entry's redaction keeps it.

DesktopErrorView.description: Exactly what an error looks like on the renderer side. There is no internal_detail member and no stack member: they are unrepresentable here, not merely omitted by convention.
